claims.claim: Athanasius of Alexandria was Archbishop of Alexandria.
The Letter to the Emperor Jovian was written in 363.
The letter was written to Emperor Jovian.
Jovian had sent a letter to Athanasius recalling him to his office and accepting him as bishop.
Athanasius wrote the letter because Jovian desired to learn the faith of the Catholic Church.
The work survives as Letter 56 (Letter LVI) in the collection of Athanasius's letters, with CPG reference 2135.
The Greek text is preserved in Patrologia Graeca 26, 813-820.
